verdict.rationale: PostHog's hosted, OAuth-gated MCP server lists 27 feature-flag tools and says agents can "ship a feature flag from a prompt." Its feature flags support targeting by person property, cohort, or group, and can be turned off instantly. The same agent is shown creating a flag targeted at @example.com emails from a single instruction. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the specific create/update/toggle flag tool names or REST flag endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent toggling and targeting flags.
